## 4. Spouses Jomil and Princess Balane Torralba

### 4.1 Identity and role

- **Princess Balane Torralba.**
  - Daughter of Gloria and Efren (ANS p.1 ¶4).
  - Born 1980 "sa mismong bahay at lupa na iyon" (JA-G p.4 S15).
  - Resides at Purok 4, San Roque, on the lot (JA-P p.2 S5–S6).
  - Elected Municipal Councilor (JA-P p.4 S19).
- **Jomil Torralba.**
  - Princess's husband and a seafarer who stays on the lot "whenever he is ashore" (ANS p.9 ¶59(d); JA-G p.4 S15).
  - Gloria's son-in-law (T3).
- **Pleaded basis of occupancy.**
  - They occupy "by authority of Gloria and Efren, as family members of the registered owners" (ANS p.2 ¶10; p.5 ¶37).
  - The Complaint pleads them as illegal possessors allowed by Gloria and Efren (CMP p.4 ¶11; p.8 ¶34).

### 4.2 Filings and positions

- **Answer:** they reside on the land (ANS p.3 ¶25), and there is no cause of action against them (ANS p.5 ¶37).
- **Princess's JA (JA-P):**
  - S7: "noong una ay nirerentahan lang ito ng aking magulang at di-kalaunan ay kanila na rin nabili".
  - S8–S9: she gave her mother money for the subdivision survey "upang ma-segregate ang bahaging binili niya".
  - S10: no participation, "maliban na lang sa tumulong ako sa gastusin sa pagpa-survey".

  - S15–S16: her parents bought, so she was not the person to talk to.
  - S21–S25: damages (the Assessor's Office inquiry by Miguel Baliza in Aug 2025; the Feb 2026 letter to the Sangguniang Bayan; reputation).
- **Jomil:** no JA is on file. His JA is "reserved" (ANS p.10 ¶61) [VERIFY].

### 4.5 Admissions and contradictions usable on cross

- **P1. Lessee origin.** "Nirerentahan lang ito ng aking magulang" (JA-P p.2 S7). This matches C1.
- **P2. "Only the survey" versus the receipts.**
  - She says she had no participation except the survey (JA-P p.3 S10).
  - About 45 receipts are in her name from 2007, including a "partial payment" (PB §2) [VERIFY DX5].
- **P3. "No objection, ever"** (JA-P p.3 S11), set against:
  - her mother's 28 May 2020 SPA to her aunt (PB §2);
  - Civil Case 8563 in 2021 (PB §2);
  - "May usapin pa yan" (2020), attributed to Princess at Annex N p.10 per PB §5.2 [VERIFY].
- **P4. Who holds the receipts.**
  - Princess is to testify to "custody of certain receipts" (ANS p.9 ¶59(c)).
  - Erwin swears the receipts and records are in his custody (JA-E pp.4–5 S16, S20–S21).
- **P5. Survey payer and title holder diverge.**
  - Princess paid for the segregation survey (JA-P p.3 S8–S9; JA-G p.7 S37).
  - Title issued to Gloria alone (PEC p.1).
- **P6. Jomil's "no notice" position.**
  - He is to testify to "no notice" (ANS p.9 ¶59(d)).
  - Versus the Aquino Law Office's receipt of King's answer in CC 8563 on 9 Jul 2021, before registration on 23 Nov 2021 (PB §2) [VERIFY the party identity; imputation is a legal point, T3].
- **P7. Rentals.**
  - Jomil is to testify to the "limited and intermittent nature of any room rentals" (ANS p.9 ¶59(d)).
  - The occupants are the household on the lot (ANS p.3 ¶25). [INFERRED] They are the people with first-hand knowledge of who collected rents.
- **P9. Receipts in her name, signed by whom [VERIFY: Jonathan statement 18 Oct].** Ask Princess who received her payments and who signed each receipt. Jonathan says Salvador alone signed them, as "Authorized Collector". Ask who appointed him, when, by what document, and whether the money reached the sisters (see 7.28).
- **P8. "Jayjay Moreno."** Princess's 2022 meeting (JA-P p.3 S13–S14) is a defense credibility line against Jonathan. Prepare Jonathan's explanation through Barandon; no contact with Princess.
